item.title: Claude Code Best Practices 2026: 15 Habits of Developers Who Ship Faster
item.description: The difference between a developer who saves 10 minutes a day with Claude Code and one who saves 3–4 hours comes down to configuration and habit. Claude Code, launched as v1.0 by Anthropic in November 2025, is not a chat interface — it’s a programmable agent runtime that operates directly inside your terminal, reads and edits your codebase autonomously, and can be extended with persistent memory, custom skills, and external tool integrations. Developer surveys in 2026 report an average 40% reduction in coding task time for teams using it properly. The 15 habits below are what separates the 40% cohort from everyone else.
